description: Mid reviewer finds a hook API issue but misses cleanup and dependency problems. Mixed performance.

prContext.title: Add usePolling hook
prContext.description: Polls an API endpoint at an interval.
prContext.instructions: Review for React best practices and correctness.

groundTruth.description: setInterval callback fires even if component unmounts — fetch/setData on unmounted component causes memory leak and React warning. Missing cleanup function.
Dependency array only includes url — if interval changes, the old interval keeps running and a new one starts. Should include interval and clear old interval.
No error handling for fetch failures — repeated 500s will spam the console and never surface to UI.
No AbortController for fetch — if component unmounts during fetch, the response may still call setData after unmount.

reviewer_comments.what: Missing cleanup for setInterval — leaks after unmount.
reviewer_comments.why: setInterval keeps firing even if component is gone.

rounds.reviewer_summary: Cleanup is blocking. Error handling recommended.

implementer_responses.updated_code: try { const res = await fetch(url); ... } catch (e) { console.error(e); }

verdict.summary: Cleanup and error handling look good.

issue_identification.rationale: Found 2 of 4 bugs (cleanup, error handling). Missed interval dependency and AbortController. Level 2-3.

prioritization.rationale: Cleanup flagged as blocking. Error handling as suggestion. Good triage. Level 3-4.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Accepted cleanup and error handling without verifying interval fix. Level 2-3.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Concrete leak explanation. Error spam rationale is good. Level 3-4.

ai_direction.rationale: Suggested cleanup and try/catch — actionable. Level 3-4.
